quranTranslation.text: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,

explanation.bs: „Sva hvala pripada Allahu, Gospodaru svjetova.“
explanation.en: “Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.”

quranTranslation.text: And say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath not taken unto Himself a son, and Who hath no partner in the Sovereignty, nor hath He any protecting friend through dependence. And magnify Him with all magnificence.

explanation.bs: „Sva hvala pripada Allahu, koji Sebi nije uzeo dijete“ – hvala za savršenstvo, ne za blagodat.
explanation.en: “Praise be to Allah, Who hath not taken unto Himself a son” — praise for perfection, not for a favour.

quranTranslation.text: And when your Lord proclaimed: If ye give thanks, I will give you more; but if ye are thankless, lo! My punishment is dire.

explanation.bs: „Ako zahvalite, sigurno ću vam dati još.“
explanation.en: “If ye give thanks, I will give you more.”

quranTranslation.text: Therefore remember Me, I will remember you. Give thanks to Me, and reject not Me.

explanation.bs: „I zahvaljujte Mi, a nemojte Mi biti nezahvalni.“
explanation.en: “Give thanks to Me, and reject not Me.”

quranTranslation.text: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: I will bring it thee before thy gaze returneth unto thee. And when he saw it set in his presence, (Solomon) said: This is of the bounty of my Lord, that He may try me whether I give thanks or am ungrateful. Whosoever giveth thanks he only giveth thanks for (the good of) his own soul; and whosoever is ungrateful (is ungrateful only to his own soul's hurt). For lo! my Lord is Absolute in independence, Bountiful.

explanation.bs: Sulejman: „da me iskuša – hoću li zahvaliti ili biti nezahvalan“.
explanation.en: Solomon: “that He may try me whether I give thanks or am ungrateful”.

quranTranslation.text: Then, when the anger of Moses abated, he took up the tablets, and in their inscription there was guidance and mercy for all those who fear their Lord.

explanation.bs: „A kad Musaova srdžba utihnu, on uze ploče“ – ljudska srdžba koja prođe.
explanation.en: “When the anger of Moses abated, he took up the tablets” — human anger that passes.

quranTranslation.text: (Saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and transgress not in respect thereof lest My wrath come upon you: and he on whom My wrath cometh, he is lost indeed.

explanation.bs: „…pa da vas ne stigne Moja srdžba“ – Allahova srdžba kao posljedica obijesti.
explanation.en: “…lest My wrath come upon you” — Allah's anger as the outcome of transgression.

quranTranslation.text: Whoso disbelieveth in Allah after his belief - save him who is forced thereto and whose heart is still content with the Faith - but whoso findeth ease in disbelief: On them is wrath from Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom.

explanation.bs: O onima koji se od vjere odmetnu: „na njima je srdžba od Allaha“ – srdžba kao presuda.
explanation.en: Upon those who disbelieve after belief: “On them is wrath from Allah” — anger as a verdict.

quranTranslation.text: Those who spend (of that which Allah hath given them) in ease and in adversity, those who control their wrath and are forgiving toward mankind; Allah loveth the good;

explanation.bs: „…i koji svoj bijes obuzdavaju (الْكَاظِمِينَ الْغَيْظَ)“ – vrlina je obuzdati najjači bijes.
explanation.en: “…those who control their wrath (الْكَاظِمِينَ الْغَيْظَ)” — the virtue of holding back the fiercest rage.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! ye are those who love them though they love you not, and ye believe in all the Scripture. When they fall in with you they say: We believe; but when they go apart they bite their finger-tips at you, for rage. Say: Perish in your rage! Lo! Allah is Aware of what is hidden in (your) breasts.

explanation.bs: „Umrite u svom bijesu!“ – bijes licemjera prema vjernicima.
explanation.en: “Perish in your rage!” — the hypocrites' fury at the believers.

quranTranslation.text: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner?

explanation.bs: Vatra, „samo što se od bijesa ne rasprsne“ – غَيْظ i za Džehennem.
explanation.en: The Fire, “as it would burst with rage” — غَيْظ said even of Hell.

quranTranslation.text: Is one who followeth the pleasure of Allah as one who hath earned condemnation from Allah, whose habitation is the Fire, a hapless journey's end?

explanation.bs: „Zar je onaj ko slijedi Allahovo zadovoljstvo kao onaj ko je navukao Allahovo nezadovoljstvo (بِسَخَطٍ)?“ – سَخَط nasuprot رِضْوَان, kako Njemu dolikuje.
explanation.en: “Is one who followeth the pleasure of Allah as one who hath earned condemnation (بِسَخَطٍ) from Allah?” — سَخَط against رِضْوَان, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: He said: O my dear son! Tell not thy brethren of thy vision, lest they plot a plot against thee. Lo! Satan is for man an open foe.

explanation.bs: „Sine moj, ne kazuj svoj san svojoj braći“ – Jusufov san, koji se ostvario (12:100).
explanation.en: “O my dear son! Tell not thy brethren of thy vision” — Joseph's dream, fulfilled in 12:100.

quranTranslation.text: And the king said: Lo! I saw in a dream seven fat kine which seven lean were eating, and seven green ears of corn and other (seven) dry. O notables! Expound for me my vision, if ye can interpret dreams.

explanation.bs: Vladar: „Recite mi šta znači moj san, ako umijete tumačiti snove“ – san sa značenjem.
explanation.en: The king: “Expound for me my vision, if ye can interpret dreams” — a dream with a meaning.

quranTranslation.text: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.

explanation.bs: „San si već obistinio“ – Ibrahimov san.
explanation.en: “Thou hast already fulfilled the vision” — Abraham's dream.

quranTranslation.text: They answered: Jumbled dreams! And we are not knowing in the interpretation of dreams.

explanation.bs: „Zbrkani snovi (أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ)! A mi tumačenje snova ne znamo“ – dvorjani o vladarevom istinitom snu.
explanation.en: “Jumbled dreams (أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ)! And we are not knowing in the interpretation of dreams” — the courtiers on the king's true dream.

quranTranslation.text: And when the children among you come to puberty then let them ask leave even as those before them used to ask it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise.

explanation.bs: „A kad djeca među vama dosegnu punoljetnost (الْحُلُم)…“ – ista riječ za punoljetnost.
explanation.en: “And when the children among you come to puberty (الْحُلُم)…” — the same word for maturity.

quranTranslation.text: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?

explanation.bs: „Zar im njihov razum (أَحْلَامُهُم) to naređuje?“ – ar-Rāġib: tumači se kao razum, jer blagost proizlazi iz razuma.
explanation.en: “Do their minds (أَحْلَامُهُم) command them to do this?” — ar-Rāġib: explained as their minds, since forbearance springs from reason.

quranTranslation.text: Return unto your father and say: O our father! Lo! thy son hath stolen. We testify only to that which we know; we are not guardians of the Unseen.

explanation.bs: „Nismo posvjedočili osim o onome što znamo“ – ar-Rāġib: ‚svjedočiti‘ ovdje znači ‚obavijestiti‘.
explanation.en: “We testify only to that which we know” — ar-Rāġib: ‘testify’ here means ‘report’.

quranTranslation.text: They said: Swear one to another by Allah that we verily will attack him and his household by night, and afterward we will surely say unto his friend: We witnessed not the destruction of his household. And lo! we are truthtellers.

explanation.bs: Zavjerenici protiv Saliha: „Nismo bili prisutni (مَا شَهِدْنَا) pogibiji njegove porodice“ – ar-Rāġib: nismo bili tu.
explanation.en: The plotters against Ṣāliḥ: “We witnessed not (مَا شَهِدْنَا) the destruction of his household” — ar-Rāġib: we were not present.

quranTranslation.text: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.

explanation.bs: „I oni koji ne svjedoče laž (لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ)“ – mnogi mufesiri: lažno svjedočenje; ar-Rāġib: ne prisustvuju laži ni tijelom ni namjerom.
explanation.en: “And those who will not witness vanity (لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ)” — many mufassirun: false testimony; ar-Rāġib: they are not present at it, in body or in intent.

quranTranslation.text: It is prescribed for you, when death approacheth one of you, if he leave wealth, that he bequeath unto parents and near relatives in kindness. (This is) a duty for all those who ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: „Propisana vam je, kad nekome od vas nastupi (حَضَرَ) smrt… oporuka“ – smrt koja nastupa.
explanation.en: “It is prescribed for you, when death approacheth (حَضَرَ) one of you … that he bequeath” — death that comes upon.

gloss.en: to be present, to come upon

quranTranslation.text: And when kinsfolk and orphans and the needy are present at the division (of the heritage), bestow on them therefrom and speak kindly unto them.

explanation.bs: „A kad diobi budu prisutni rođaci, siročad i siromasi, dajte im nešto od toga“ – prisutnost ljudi.
explanation.en: “And when kinsfolk and orphans and the needy are present at the division (of the heritage), bestow on them therefrom” — people being present.

gloss.en: to be present, to come upon

quranTranslation.text: And when We inclined toward thee (Muhammad) certain of the jinn, who wished to hear the Qur'an and, when they were in its presence, said: Give ear! and, when it was finished, turned back to their people, warning.

explanation.bs: Džini koji slušaju Kur'an – „a kad su bili prisutni (حَضَرُوهُ), rekoše: Utihnite!“
explanation.en: The jinn listening to the Quran — “when they were in its presence (حَضَرُوهُ), said: Give ear!”

gloss.en: to be present, to come upon

quranTranslation.text: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.

explanation.bs: „K Njemu se uspinju meleki i Duh“ – kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “The angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him” — as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: He knoweth that which goeth into the earth and that which cometh forth from it, and that descendeth from the heaven and that which ascendeth into it. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.

explanation.bs: „… i ono što se uspinje u nj“ – ono što se diže prema nebu.
explanation.en: “… and that which ascendeth into it” — whatever rises towards the sky.

quranTranslation.text: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,

explanation.bs: „Pa i da im otvorimo jedna vrata na nebu, i da se oni kroz njih stalno uspinju …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it …” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Whoso desireth power (should know that) all power belongeth to Allah. Unto Him good words ascend, and the pious deed doth He exalt; but those who plot iniquities, theirs will be an awful doom; and the plotting of such (folk) will come to naught.

explanation.bs: „Lijepe riječi uzdižu se do Njega“ – riječi roba koje stižu k Allahu, kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Unto Him good words ascend” — the servant's words reaching Allah, as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Or thou have a house of gold; or thou ascend up into heaven, and even then we will put no faith in thine ascension till thou bring down for us a book that we can read. Say (O Muhammad): My Lord be Glorified! Am I aught save a mortal messenger?

explanation.bs: „… ili da se na nebo popneš – a ni penjanju tvome nećemo vjerovati dok nam s neba ne spustiš knjigu da je čitamo“ – zahtjev nevjernika.
explanation.en: “… or thou ascend up into heaven, and even then we will put no faith in thine ascension till thou bring down for us a book that we can read” — the deniers' demand.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah. And let every soul look to that which it sendeth on before for the morrow. And observe your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „… i neka svaka duša pogleda šta je za sutra poslala unaprijed …“ – djelo poslano naprijed, prema danu koji dolazi.
explanation.en: “And let every soul look to that which it sendeth on before for the morrow” — the deed sent ahead, toward the day to come.

quranTranslation.text: Establish worship, and pay the poor-due; and whatever of good ye send before (you) for your souls, ye will find it with Allah. Lo! Allah is Seer of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „… a svako dobro što unaprijed pošaljete za svoje duše, zateći ćete kod Allaha …“ – dobro poslano naprijed, koje čeka svoga činitelja.
explanation.en: “… and whatever of good ye send before (you) for your souls, ye will find it with Allah” — good sent ahead, waiting for its doer.

quranTranslation.text: There doth every soul experience that which it did aforetime, and they are returned unto Allah, their rightful Lord, and that which they used to invent hath failed them.

explanation.bs: „Ondje će svaka duša iskusiti ono što je ranije učinila, a svi će se vratiti k Allahu, svome pravom Gospodaru …“ – pogled unatrag, na ranije učinjeno.
explanation.en: “There doth every soul experience that which it did aforetime, and they are returned unto Allah, their rightful Lord” — a look back at what was done before.

gloss.en: to have done before, in time past

quranTranslation.text: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.

explanation.bs: „Jedite i pijte, neka vam je ugodno, kao nagradu za ono što ste ranije učinili, u danima kojih više nema“ – stanovnicima Dženneta se govori o prošlim danima.
explanation.en: The people of the Garden are told to eat and drink at ease for what they did before, in the days gone by — aslafa looks back on deeds from the Hereafter.

gloss.en: to have done before, in time past

quranTranslation.text: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!

explanation.bs: „Okrećeš li se ti od mojih bogova, Ibrahime? Ne odustaneš li, zasut ću te kamenjem! Idi od mene na duže vrijeme!“ – prekid uz prijetnju; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!” — a break with a threat; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! those who believe, and those who emigrate (to escape the persecution) and strive in the way of Allah, these have hope of Allah's mercy. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Zaista, vjernici, i oni što ostaviše domove i uložiše trud na Allahovom putu – to su oni koji se Allahovoj milosti nadaju …“ – iseljenje uz vjeru i trud.
explanation.en: “Those who believe, and those who emigrate (to escape the persecution) and strive in the way of Allah, these have hope of Allah's mercy” — emigration together with faith and striving.

quranTranslation.text: And those who became fugitives for the cause of Allah after they had been oppressed, We verily shall give them goodly lodging in the world, and surely the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if they but knew;

explanation.bs: „A one koji su se zbog Allaha iselili pošto su trpjeli nepravdu – Mi ćemo im na ovom svijetu dati lijepo boravište …“ – iseljenje zbog progona.
explanation.en: Those who emigrated for Allah's sake after they had been wronged are promised a goodly home in this world — emigration under persecution.

quranTranslation.text: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.

explanation.bs: „Povući ću se od vas i od onoga što, mimo Allaha, prizivate, a ja ću moliti svoga Gospodara …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And when ye withdraw from them and that which they worship except Allah, then seek refuge in the Cave; your Lord will spread for you of His mercy and will prepare for you a pillow in your plight.

explanation.bs: „Pošto ste se odvojili od njih i od svega čemu oni robuju mimo Allaha, potražite utočište u pećini …“ – mladići iz pećine; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And when ye withdraw from them and that which they worship except Allah, then seek refuge in the Cave” — the young men of the Cave; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
